caption: The video captures a transparent cylindrical container brimming with water against a black background, its surface already thrown into a crown-shaped splash. Two tall lateral spikes flank the crown, each capped by a suspended droplet and joined by a thin curved wall, while a turbulent column rises from the center. As the clip unfolds, the wall subsides, its edge lowering and raggeding, and both spikes tilt outward so their tip droplets drift farther apart. The central column persists, a rounded blob swelling at its apex while a mound at its base sprouts small peripheral spikes. Free droplets above drift outward and downward as the whole assembly eases slightly downward. The water inside shows evolving ripples and a deforming meniscus, the structure still changing at the final frame.
